BLACKWOOD MANOR

A procedurally generated survival shooter. Find the way out. Don't get caught.

Hold FIRE and drag on it to aim while shooting. Hold the context button for hold actions (fuse boxes). At a piano the keys appear on screen.
WASD move   Mouse look   LMB shoot   RMB / Z aim / scope (tap to toggle)   R reload
1 2 3 / wheel switch weapon   Shift sprint   C crouch   E doors, breaker, exit
F flashlight   M map   Esc pause
Online: Enter / T chat   V voice chat on / off
E also: sit at the piano, pull a bottle, hide in a bathtub, taps, curtains, cabinets, knock, read notes, stroke the cat, give allies orders
Hold E fix a fuse box (co-op)   At the piano: A S D F G H J K L ; white keys, W E T Y U O P black keys, Q songbook, Backspace stop song, Z / X octave, Esc / Space stand up

PLAY TOGETHER

Two players in the same manor, over the internet. One hosts and sends the other a code or an invite link.

Online play contacts the PeerJS matchmaking server (0.peerjs.com) to find your partner; the game itself then runs directly between your two browsers. Nothing goes online unless you host or join.
